root_cause.text: The driver sent the 6E-related command MCC_ALLOWED_AP_TYPE_CMD based only on device family (AX210 or newer) without checking whether the device actually supports 6E (UHB), causing a firmware crash on older devices like AX201 whose firmware erroneously advertised support for this command.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `|| !mvm->trans->cfg->uhb_supported` to the existing device family check; the commit message states that firmware on AX201 mistakenly advertises support for this command, leading to a crash when sent.
